
import math
n = 20
x = 18
z = 1.96
p = x / n
z2 = z*z
denom = 1 + z2/n
center = (p + z2/(2*n)) / denom
half = (z/denom) * math.sqrt(p*(1-p)/n + z2/(4*n*n))
lower = center - half
upper = center + half
print("p_hat =", p)
print("z^2 =", z2)
print("z^2/n =", z2/n)
print("z^2/(2n) =", z2/(2*n))
print("denom =", denom)
print("center =", center)
print("half =", half)
print("lower =", lower)
print("upper =", upper)
# 中间量
print("p(1-p)/n =", p*(1-p)/n)
print("z^2/(4n^2) =", z2/(4*n*n))
print("inside sqrt =", p*(1-p)/n + z2/(4*n*n))
print("sqrt =", math.sqrt(p*(1-p)/n + z2/(4*n*n)))
# 对照：Wald 仅作概念说明（不采用数值结论）
print("wald_half =", z*math.sqrt(p*(1-p)/n))
print("lower*100 =", lower*100, "upper*100 =", upper*100)
print("width =", upper-lower)
